toolTips.amount: Net amount is always calculated as gross − commission. Not editable.
toolTips.amountGross: Gross before fees. Net = gross − commission. Required. Clearing to 0 zeros fee/%/net (only when you change this field).
toolTips.commissionAmount: Fee in currency. Changing this recalculates %. Empty = 0. Cannot exceed gross.
toolTips.commissionPercent: Fee as %. Changing this recalculates fee €. Empty = 0.

messages.stripeSourcedReadOnly: This ledger entry comes from Stripe. Stripe-sourced fields are read-only; you can only change assigned user, teams, and Model D classification.
messages.grossRequired: Gross amount (lordo) is required. Net is calculated automatically.
messages.stripeManualCreateBlocked: Stripe platform can only be set by website donation ingest. Choose another payment platform for manual ledger entries.
messages.platformImmutable: Payment platform cannot be changed after the ledger entry is created.

modelDClassification.A: A — Income and expenses from general-interest activities
modelDClassification.B: B — Income and expenses from other activities
modelDClassification.C: C — Income and expenses from fundraising activities
modelDClassification.D: D — Income and expenses from financial and asset activities
modelDClassification.E: E — General support income and expenses
